DALLAS, Aug. 29, 2025 -- Applied Digital announced today that it has finalized a new lease agreement with CoreWeave for an additional 150MW at its Polaris Forge 1 Campus.

This new lease agreement with CoreWeave brings Applied Digital's total anticipated contracted lease revenue to approximately $11B, which includes $7B in revenue from the initial two approximately 15-year leases executed in May of this year.

With this new long-term lease agreement, the total critical IT capacity across these three long-term lease agreements will encompass 400MW across the campus.

The company closed $375 million in financing for its Ellendale campus.
